entities.name: Generic transport of NAS messages procedure
entities.description: Procedure to carry protocol messages from various applications in an encapsulated form between the MME and the UE. It may be initiated by the UE or the network.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: UE state where the UE is attached for EPS services and has an active connection.

entities.name: UE attached for EPS services
entities.description: Condition that the UE must be attached for EPS services to use the generic transport procedure.

relations.description: The generic transport procedure can only be used when the UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode.
The generic transport procedure requires that the UE is attached for EPS services.
